ruling.explanation: Rider, your $4.00 is refunded in full. Driver, the no-show fee cannot stand, and here is why. The fee is chargeable only if the driver's GPS trace places the vehicle inside the 50 m pickup geofence at Raffles Place Exit A (a STANDARD zone) and holds it there continuously for 300 seconds. Your own trace, EV-GPS-00212, carries 93 driver fixes but not one of them passes the 25 m horizontal-accuracy filter POL-NS-02 requires, so the record yields zero qualifying in-geofence fixes and a measured in-geofence dwell of 0 seconds against the 300-second minimum - a 300-second shortfall. The closest raw reading (37.9 m) is an unverified fix and under POL-NS-02 counts as evidence of neither presence nor absence. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full, whether or not the rider was physically present. The chat log shows the driver answered the rider's locating message in 28 seconds, so POL-NS-04 does not apply, and no advisory could have reduced the minimum in any event. I have NOT escalated. The apparent clash between the trip record (an 'arrived' tap at 08:12:35 and a stated 7.9-minute wait) and the trace (zero dwell) is not a POL-NS-09(b) conflict, because POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap, so the policy resolves it. The profile counters POL-NS-09(c) and (d) read are both at zero, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations across 132 trips, 1.5%), and the deciding fact is carried by EV-GPS-00212 at weight_multiplier 1.0, above the 0.70 floor. Driver, you receive no compensation: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not; POL-NS-03 does not rescue it either, since the rider named Exit A, the trip's single registered pickup point, and with registered_pickup_points at 1 the pin-ambiguity goodwill of POL-NS-03(ii) is unavailable. For completeness, EV-ADVIS-00212-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and carries no fact; its absence closes the POL-NS-06(i) interval-summing route, which could not have helped the driver regardless. No false-arrival referral is recorded under POL-NS-05(ii), because the record does not identify the vehicle's position or speed at the 08:12:35 arrival timestamp and that clause's trigger cannot be run. Party profiles (ratings, account ages, lifetime counters such as prior_no_show_flags) are context only and carried no weight in this decision.
